anchor: Which large, barely-thinking beast can scale ceilings without rolling any checks and has a jaw attack of 1d8 plus 2?
What low-intellect creature with a 40-foot climbing speed sees in the dark for 60 feet and has 19 hit points?
What sword enchantment lets me spend a quick extra move and a spoken word to set my blade ablaze, adding 2d6 scorching damage?
Which enchanted melee weapon sheds bright light across a 40-foot radius and stays lit until I speak the command again or put it away?
Which creature gets a defensive reaction that adds 5 to its defense rating when a melee hit lands while it is wielding a weapon?
Which ancient winged creature can, right after another creature's turn, spend one of three extra actions to send a foe to a harmless pocket dimension until its next turn?
Can an ancient winged foe get extra moves between other creatures' turns, and does it dash in to claw me afterward?
Which wearable garment needs a short bonding ritual, and makes other people's spotting rolls against me harder while I get an edge on sneaking?
Which very large otherworldly beast can knock a target flat after charging at it 20 feet, and also deals holy damage with its headbutt?
Which good-aligned creature shrugs off life-draining and sacred-light harm and moves 60 feet across the ground with 42 hit points?
Which fourth-level spell wraps me in flickering light, letting me pick frost or heat resistance and punishing any creature that hits me up close?
Is there a 10-minute self-cast that makes melee attackers within 5 feet take 2d8 damage each time they strike me?
Which 24-hour ritual consecrates a 60-foot area so chosen types of demons or the restless dead can't willingly step inside?
Could a sacred zone be set up so that lesser magical lights can't brighten it, filling it with murk?
Which 8-hour warding spell lets me pick between a bell-like chime or a mental ping when someone touches or enters a guarded door?
How could I be woken from sleep by a mind-only signal if someone enters my guarded camp a mile away?
What sticky netting spell fills a 20-foot cube, holding creatures who fail a dexterity roll, and burns away when hit by flame?
If sticky strands trap someone, how do they break free, and what happens to the magic if nothing anchors it between two walls?
Which 10-minute spell lets me raise every pool in a 100-foot square by twenty feet, or split it to leave a dry trench?
Is there a spell that makes a crashing twenty-foot surge sweep vessels across a lake and maybe capsize them?
How many kinds of everyday or warlike close-combat arms can I train with at first level, and when can I swap one of my picks?
Will the list of close-combat implements I can use special tricks with grow as I level up?
Instead of a combat talent, can a wilderness fighter pick two nature cantrips, using Wisdom to cast them, and swap one each time they level?
For a woodland tracker at second level, do the nature cantrips chosen this way count as that class's own spells?
Can a headpiece let me understand any spoken or written tongue, and what spell does it hold?
Which artifact crystal globe can take over my mind if I fail a fifteen-point charisma roll after peering inside, forcing me to follow its evil wishes?
Which crystal sphere holds seven charges, regains 1d4 + 3 each dawn, and can cast a bright-light spell for a single charge?
Which tiny beast can slip out of an enemy's reach without inviting a parting strike, and only has a single hit point?
What small pest-like creature with 1 hit point can climb at 20 feet and see in the dark for 30 feet?
Which medium humanoid species sees in darkness up to 60 feet and picks a heritage that grants a supernatural power?
At character levels 3 and 5, does this humanoid ancestry gain a free higher-level spell castable once after an extended sleep?
Which spellcaster can blink short distances as a quick extra move, and can block incoming magic in a reaction, three times a day?
Which humanoid caster makes three magical strikes per turn, each dealing 3d8 plus 3 force damage, and can unleash an explosive blast twice a day?
What rarity-based enchantment gives a suit of protective gear a one-to-three bonus to defense depending on how scarce it is?
Which large beast with a thirty-foot swim speed can hold its breath for an hour and clamp onto a medium-sized or smaller creature, pinning it in place?
How long can a large aquatic beast with 13 hit points stay submerged before it needs air?
If I'm knocked out cold, do enemies get an edge on hitting me, and does any blow landing within 5 feet become a critical hit?
What happens to my movement and held items if I'm knocked out, and do I end up flat on my face?
What rod of spellpower regains four six-sided dice plus two charges each dawn, and sometimes a bonus when its last charge is spent?
How many charges does summoning an elemental from a rod of spellpower cost, or stepping between planes?
Which option for a sacred area lets chosen creatures communicate across any language inside it?
Can a sacred area make chosen creatures weaker against one kind of harm, or make it so no noise leaves or enters?
At character level 5, can I swell to a bigger body as a quick extra move, and gain advantage on strength checks for ten minutes?
If someone has me pinned, do I get an edge on the roll to break free, and do I haul more than my size suggests?
Which 9th-level spell instantly refills one visible ally's life totals and ends charm, fear, paralysis, poison, or stun effects within 60 feet?
Can a nine-tier restorative wake a fallen comrade lying on the ground, letting it stand up with its reaction?
Which large, lawful-good winged beast's cone breath first leaves you briefly unable to act, then freezes you solid on a second failed Constitution roll?
Which winged metal-scaled creature with 168 hit points is immune to frost and senses nearby foes without sight up to thirty feet?
At third level, can a martial-class warrior choose a specialty, and does it keep granting perks as they gain levels?
What gust barrier can I raise within 120 feet, shaped as a continuous line up to 50 feet long, that batters creatures for 4d8 and blocks small flyers?
Can a mass of blustery air stop fog and gas clouds, and deflect arrows aimed at people hiding behind it?
At which high character level does a woodland stalker class first reach six favored-foe picks and fourteen prepared spells?
At level 19 of this wilderness class, how many spells are prepared, and what new capstone choice arrives?
What jewelry can I spend one to three charges on, sending glowing motes at a point 60 feet away to strike a 15-foot cube for 5d4 holy damage?
Is there a magical band that lets me sprinkle sparks onto a 15-foot area, where a success on a DC 15 dexterity roll halves the harm?
At level 14, can I spend a quick extra move to unnerve foes within 30 feet with a Wisdom roll, leaving them rattled for a minute?
Is a fear-inducing shout limited to one use per extended sleep, and can spending a rage charge restore it early?
Which medium restless spirit can pass through walls and creatures, hover in place, and is immune to paralysis, grappling and being knocked prone?
Which spirit with 45 hit points and a grasp that deals 19 life-draining damage can slip into the faint shadow realm for a while?
Which five-pound kit lets me mend a tear in clothes or sew a tiny pattern at DC 10, and lets me make rope, sacks, or tents?
Which celestial guardian can raise the dead once a day, cast weather-control, and use a quick extra action twice a day to heal or hide?
Which angelic being can sense wicked or righteous creatures at will and speak with the gods once a day?
What crystal sphere can I activate to draw all the multicolored wyrms within 40 miles, but only once every hour?
Which globe-shaped relic can be destroyed only by a +3 weapon or a disintegration effect, and has an armor rating of 20?
Which evil shapeshifting beast in pig form can gore a humanoid and curse it so that if it falls to zero hit points it becomes one of its kind?
Which 97-hit-point shapeshifter throws spears or charges a victim twenty feet to knock it flat?
What 10-minute aura centered on me, 15 feet across, halves enemies' speed and blasts those who fail a Wisdom roll for 3d8?
Can an evil caster's circle of spectral wraiths deal life-draining damage each time a creature enters or ends its turn inside?
Which cloak can sprout a pair of feathered appendages granting 60-foot aerial travel for an hour, but leaves me falling if they vanish mid-air?
Once that cloak's airborne feature ends, how many hours of waiting follow, rolled on a twelve-sided die?
Which large construct breathes a cone that first pins victims in place, then turns them to stone on a second failed save?
Is there an armored construct with 114 hit points that is immune to being turned to stone and can knock a foe flat with a 20-foot charge?
